Keep chemicals away from children, animals and food.
Concentrated acids and solvents are for trained laboratory staff only.
Dispose of samples and reagents safely.

limits.title: What colour tests cannot detect
items: Antibiotic residues need a test kit or laboratory.
Aflatoxin M1 needs a kit or laboratory.
Natural colour varies with breed, feed and season.

sources.title: Sources
sources.body: Test ideas follow the FSSAI DART method and the 2019 adulterant manual, and ICAR-NDRI guidance. Content has not been checked against the originals: verify before real use.

A1.title: Water in milk (glass slide)
steps: Put one drop of milk on a clean, polished glass slide.
Hold the slide at a slant.
Watch the drop. Do not touch it.
A1.neg: Stays or flows slowly, leaving a white trail (Not detected)
A1.pos: Runs off at once, no trail (Suspected)

A2.title: Detergent in milk (shake)
steps: Take 5 to 10 ml milk in a clean bottle and add the same amount of water.
Close the bottle and shake well.

A3.title: Starch in milk (iodine)
steps: Put about 3 ml milk in a clean glass. If it was boiled, cool it to room temperature.
Add 2 to 3 drops of tincture of iodine.
